chunks: Al-Sakuni narrated with his chain of transmission, saying:
ʿAli عليه السلام said concerning a woman who vowed to perform tawaf on all fours: “She is to perform one week for her hands and one week for her feet.”

key_terms.أُسْبُوعًا: A complete tawaf of seven rounds
key_terms.تَطُوفَ: To perform tawaf around the Ka'bah
key_terms.عَلَى أَرْبَعٍ: On all fours, using both hands and feet
key_terms.لِرِجْلَيْهَا: For her two feet, meaning one tawaf counted in relation to them
key_terms.لِيَدَيْهَا: For her two hands, meaning one tawaf counted in relation to them
key_terms.نَذَرَتْ: She made a vow binding herself to an act

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman vows to perform tawaf on all fours?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman's vow connected to tawaf in hajj. Imam ʿAli عليه السلام rules that the vow is fulfilled by assigning one complete tawaf for the hands and one complete tawaf for the feet.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3120 - Al-Sakuni narrated with his chain of transmission that

Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) was asked about a woman who vowed to perform Tawaf on all fours.
Imam (as) said: "She should perform one circuit (seven rounds) for her hands and one circuit for her feet."
